about.metaDescription: SciOArt — science and art from Punjab's fields. Our mission, team and how our work is made.
about.title: About SciOArt
about.lead: SciOArt joins agricultural science with the arts of film, song, theatre, play and storytelling.
about.mission: To turn farm science into films, songs, plays, games and books that people enjoy and share — in Punjabi and English, on any phone.
about.story1: People remember a song, a story or a game long after they forget a lecture. SciOArt creates and collects that kind of material, made with PAU's scientists and Punjab's artists.
about.story2: SciOArt shares materials only. It does not give personal farm advice or answer individual questions.
about.partners: SciOArt is used by Punjab Agricultural University, Ludhiana. Partnerships with artists, schools and institutions are being planned.
about.made1: Each piece starts from research at Punjab Agricultural University.
about.made2: Writers, singers, actors and designers turn it into a song, film, play, game or book.
about.made3: A PAU subject expert checks the science and the Punjabi.
about.made4: It is published here, free to watch, listen, play, download and share.
about.contact: Ideas, corrections or partnership proposals? Write to us.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: We collect as little as possible.
privacy.s1: Nothing that identifies you. SciOArt has no accounts and no forms.
privacy.s2: Your language, theme and recent searches are saved only on your own device. You can clear them by clearing your browser data.
privacy.s3: SciOArt does not use advertising or tracking cookies. Videos open on YouTube or Facebook only when you press play or follow a link.
privacy.s4: Write to us if you have any question about your privacy.
